idea-plugin.name: Tool Finder
idea-plugin.description:
Find and open IDE tool windows from a keyboard-driven popup.

Press Ctrl+\ (Cmd+\ on macOS) to open Tool Finder, and again to close it. Type to filter tool windows by name or ID. The list separates active, recent and new tool windows, and each row shows the tool window's own IDE shortcut when it has one.

Shortcuts
  • Up / Down - move the selection
  • Enter - activate the selected tool window, or hide it when it is the focused one
  • Delete / Backspace - hide the selected active tool window while the search field is empty
  • Esc - clear the search, then close the popup
Unavailable tool windows can be included under Settings | Tools | Tool Finder. They are shown dimmed and cannot be activated in the current context. The same page toggles the tool window shortcuts.

The shortcut can be changed under Settings | Keymap by searching for Tool Finder. The action is also available from Tools | Tool Finder.
